Acceptance criteria: this PR no longer upgrades Error Prone anywhere, no upgrade-only adaptations remain, and all other dependency updates remain intact. Run the narrowest relevant formatting and validation commands, including custom-checks compilation/tests where feasible, and report any validation blocker.
